summary: to_json converts a variable into a JSON string via json.dumps to force JSON string output; cls and default arguments are ignored, and vault_to_text/preprocess_unsafe defaulted to False in 2.9 to 2.12.
questions: How do I convert a variable to a JSON string?
Why does Ansible turn my JSON string back into a dict?
Which json.dumps options are ignored by to_json?

answer_card.title: to_json filter
answer_card.answer_md: `{{ data | to_json }}` serializes a variable to a JSON string via Python's `json.dumps`. Ansible auto-converts JSON strings into structures, so use this to force a string. The `cls` and `default` arguments are overridden internally. `vault_to_text` and `preprocess_unsafe` defaulted to False between 2.9 and 2.12.
